category.title: What's your goal?
category.lead: Pick a category. We adapt sessions to the event, the distance, or your level.

level.title: What's your current swimming level?
level.lead: Pick the one that describes you today — not the one you’re aiming for.

découverte.label: Getting started
découverte.desc: I stop after a few lengths

régulier.label: Beginner
régulier.desc: I can swim lengths, but I’m still learning

sportif.label: Intermediate
sportif.desc: I’m comfortable in the pool, but I want to improve

performance.label: Advanced
performance.desc: I’m an experienced swimmer. I can swim all four strokes.

level.beginnerBlocked: Start smaller. Rome wasn't built in a day. We can't promise you'll make it to the finish.

pool.title: Your pool
pool.lead: How long is the pool you swim in?
pool.hint: 25 m is the most common pool. 50 m is the long course (often Olympic). Your sessions will be set to that length.

frequency.title: Sessions per week
frequency.lead: Your Premium trial unlocks the full training load from day one. We assume a 25 m pool — you can change pool, gear and strokes later in Profile.

physique.title: Your profile
physique.lead: Date of birth, weight and height — to better adapt your plan.

injury.title: Injury?
injury.lead: Optional. Used to adapt your sessions if you want.
injury.consentHint: Tick the box above to declare an injury or discomfort.
injury.yes: Yes, I have an injury / discomfort

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.desc: Frequent pain, intensity should be limited

health.checkbox: I explicitly agree that MySWYM may process my heart rate and my injury / discomfort declarations to adapt my sessions and help prevent injury. I can refuse.
health.body: To adapt your sessions and reduce injury risk, MySWYM may process health data under the GDPR: per-session heart rate (e.g. via Strava) and the injury / discomfort history you declare. Legal basis: your explicit consent (GDPR art. 9.2.a). It is optional: you can refuse and still use the app. You can withdraw consent at any time (Settings or contact@myswym.app). This data is not sent to third-party analytics tools.
health.medical: Generated plans are indicative and do not replace professional medical advice. Check your fitness (medical certificate if needed) before following the programme.
health.declaration: I certify that the health information I provide is accurate.
health.safety: Train according to how you feel. Stop if you have worrying symptoms and see a health professional if needed. Open water: never swim alone.

equipment.title: What equipment do you have?
equipment.lead: You can tick several, or none. We only use gear you have — never kit you don’t.
equipment.noneHint: I swim without fins, kickboard, etc.

distance.title: What distance do you want to swim on average per session?
distance.lead: No need to be exact — just the distance you usually like to swim.
distance.label: Average distance per session

prefs.title: Your strokes
prefs.lead: Tell us what you prefer — we’ll shape your sessions around it.
prefs.leadOpen: Tell us your favourite stroke — in triathlon and open water we mostly work freestyle.

crawl.label: Freestyle
crawl.desc: I mostly like to swim freestyle

4_nages.label: IM / all strokes
4_nages.desc: I want to mix butterfly, backstroke, breaststroke and freestyle

date.title: Event date?
date.lead: At least 6 weeks for a solid plan.
date.label: Event date

auth.loginLead: Log in with Google or your email.
auth.registerLead: 7-day trial, no card. Then your sessions pause.
auth.registerReferral: Referral code {{code}} — 20% off your first Premium invoice.
auth.resetLead: Enter your email and we’ll send a reset link.
auth.age: I confirm I am 18 or over.
auth.terms: I accept the <cgu>terms of use</cgu> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
auth.trial: 7-day trial at account creation, no card. Then your sessions pause until you subscribe.
auth.googleBlocked: Tick both boxes below to continue with Google.
auth.needChecks: Confirm you are 18+ and accept the terms / privacy policy to create an account.
auth.exists: An account already exists with this email.
auth.created: Account created! Check your email to confirm, then log in.
auth.createdReferral: Account created! Referral saved — check your email, then log in.
auth.resetSent: Email sent! Check your inbox to reset your password.
auth.socialOff: This sign-in method isn’t enabled yet. Try email, or come back in a moment.
